vulnerability.name: CVE-2025-15367
vulnerability.description: CPython poplib: newlines in a user-controlled command inject further POP3 commands

statements.impact_statement: The catalog service never imports poplib: not its own code (catalog/), nor any of its seven pinned dependencies (anyio, click, h11, idna, starlette, typing-extensions, uvicorn; checked 2026-10-18 by unpacking the locked wheels: 166 Python files, no poplib import). It speaks HTTP only. Scoped to the catalog image: run-python and build-python still report it, since another app on them could use poplib. Revisit when catalog's dependencies change; remove when Wolfi's python-3.14 ships the upstream fix.
